scope: 只读 shell 分类与跨会话任务误拦截修复；不更改任务归属保护或旧配置迁移策略

local_full_initial.note: Specific write-denial reasons replaced by HOOK_DEADLINE under load, plus package relocation and workspace test timeouts; assertions were not relaxed.

isolated_retest.note: All failed groups rerun sequentially with independent temporary directory; packaged MCP/hooks and cross-session regression included.

limits: 静态规则覆盖已知命令与支持的包装，不推导任意解释器脚本。
Windows CI 运行原生 PowerShell 和真实打包 MCP/钩子；不等同在同事设备上实际安装或完整 Codex UI 验收。
只记录固定分类原因码，不含命令、参数、业务正文或路径。
原生宿主更新后仍需审查变更钩子并加载新会话。
